messages:
maria (partnerships): FYI — had a roadmap sync with Nvidia/AMD/Graphcore this morning. Wanted to capture key timing and risks for marketplace and Dedicated planning.

aj (infra): thanks. big ask: do we have a short matrix of which SKUs are SXM only vs PCIe? that affects our Dedicated fleet plans.

maria (partnerships): Nvidia said H200 public-ish windows: early access Q2-Q3 2026 (partner skus), broad availability H2 2026. B200 (PCIe) ramps slightly after H200. MI300 (AMD) timeline: partner previews Q3 2026, GA late 2026. Gaudi2/Graphcore: samples Q3 2026 but better perf numbers in Q4.

ryan (eng-runtime): noted. big practical dependency: NVIDIA kernel/drivers and NCCL stacks need to be in our AMI before can validate multi-GPU batching. can we get partner images? @maria can you request vendor AMI/deliverables?

maria (partnerships): already requested AMIs and driver bundles; Nvidia promised access keys for partner repo next week. AMD asked for an NDA addendum for early MI300 firmware.

aj (infra): can we avoid SXM-only lock? if H200 SXM first we should plan capacity as mixed-instance pools with fallback to H100 PCIe until H200 PCIe SKUs ship. Also need power/cooling estimates for H200 density.

ryan (eng-runtime): agreed. also want to track quantized kernel availability for B200 — without INT8/4 kernels cost per token remains high. ask: vendor ETA for quant kernels?

maria (partnerships): Nvidia: quant kernels work in dev branches now, mainline in driver 545-ish (vendor estimate). B200 specific optimizations likely to appear in later cuDNN/NCCL releases. AMD: MI300 quant stack is upstreaming ROCm updates; Graphcore working on Poplar optimizations for our runtime.

denver-gpu-biz (vendor-bot): Reminder: Joint announcement windows typically require a 4-week legal review + 2-week comms prep. Vendor marketing teams prefer coordinated press the week of GA for maximum reach.

sophia (product): For Redwood Console feature flags: we need a model-variant tagging scheme so customers can target H200 vs H100 vs mixed. Also, rollout plan for Dedicated: canary on small tenant pool, then region-scale.

nathan (solutions): SI partners asked about integration timelines for on-prem kits (MI300/Gaudi). They need firmware, validated Kubespecs, and an SRE runbook. Can we prepare a "starter kit" doc?

aj (infra): will start a draft Kubespec and list of required firmware/kernel versions. ask: who owns the SRE runbook? @ryan or @nathan?

ryan (eng-runtime): I can own a runtime validation runbook; nathan can own SI install/runbook. we'll collaborate on test harness and perf dashboards.

maria (partnerships): action items captured below. I'll ping vendor contacts for firm dates and AMIs.

ACTION ITEMS:
1) maria: collect vendor AMIs, driver bundles, and NDA addendum status by 1763663600 (24h).
2) aj: draft Kubespec + power/cooling estimations for H200 density (first cut 1763667200).
3) ryan: runtime validation runbook + perf tests (benchmark scripts + target metrics) — initial PR 1763670800.
4) nathan: SI starter kit outline + on-prem checklist (first draft 1763674400).
5) sophia: Console tagging schema & canary rollout plan (draft 1763678000).

maria (partnerships): also note comms: vendor marketing want 2-week heads-up before announcement. we should avoid lockstep if legal/PCI/partner NDA not ready. keep flexibility. :white_check_mark:

aj (infra): one risk: BMC firmware support on some older trays may block Gaudi/Mi300 installs. I'll flag affected SKUs in the Kubespec.

ryan (eng-runtime): can we add a tiny smoke test that runs on CI with vendor AMI to catch early regressions? 30s end-to-end generation w/ KV cache warm.

maria (partnerships): yes — request that from vendors. I'll ask Nvidia/AMD/Graphcore for partner CI images and a minimal perf harness.

sophia (product): tagging note: customers should be able to request "best cost" (B200) vs "lowest latency" (H200 SXM) — map to our routing policies.

maria (partnerships): great. If no objections I'll lock these action owners and follow up with a weekly sync cadence until GA windows stabilise.

nathan (solutions): 👍 I'll start the SI kit doc and drop a link here when ready.

ryan (eng-runtime): +1 on weekly sync. will add perf metric templates.

maria (partnerships): thanks all. closing the thread for now, will post updated timeline when vendors confirm. :wave:
